'''Wasaka berry pie''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made from [[Wasaka berry/Legends|wasaka berries]] with a [[Kashyyyk wheat flour]] crust. The [[Pie/Legends|pie]] was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The restaurant menu claimed that diner's staff had gathered and pitted the wasaka berries. The diner charged 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a "[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]&ndash;sized slice" of the pie or 5.7 credits for the slice with a scoop of [[denta bean ice cream]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wasaka berry pie was first mentioned in "[[Wasaka Berries and Monster Ships: Star Wars Storybook 101]]," an article  written by [[Craig Robert Carey]] with [[Victor Wertz]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 74|seventy&ndash;fourth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Wasaka Berries">{{InsiderCite|74|Wasaka Berries and Monster Ships: Star Wars Storybook 101|Wasaka Berries and Monster Ships: ''Star Wars'' Storybook 101}}</ref> which released on [[February 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2004/01/news20040126.html|text=Clone Trooper Front and Center in ''Insider'' #74}}</ref> The article mentions wasaka berry pie when summarizing the plot<ref name="Wasaka Berries" /> of the [[1979]] picture book ''[[The Wookiee Storybook]]'' by [[Eleanor Ehrhardt]]. However, the plot of ''The Wookiee Storybook'' is actually about collecting wasaka berries for [[Wasaka Berry Pudding]], not for wasaka berry pie.<ref name="Wasaka Berries" />

Wasaka berry pie was first properly mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> In a blog post about writing "Dining at Dex's," Gregory Walker stated that they developed wasaka berry pie for the article from its initial pitch.<ref name="Story Behind the Story">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> It was later pictured in the [[2014]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Assault Team]]'', developed by [[Disney Mobile]] and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Assault Team">''[[Star Wars: Assault Team]]''</ref>
